0.headline: Technocraft Ventures IPO allotment today: How to check status on BSE, NSE and registrar
0.heading: Technocraft Ventures IPO allotment today: How to check status on BSE, NSE and registrar
0.intro: The share allotment for Technocraft Ventures' Rs 251.88-crore initial public offering (IPO) is expected to be finalised today, August 12, following strong demand from investors during the three-day bidding period.
0.body:
The share allotment for Technocraft Ventures' Rs 251.88-crore initial public offering (IPO) is expected to be finalised today, August 12, following strong demand from investors during the three-day bidding period.

The IPO of the wastewater treatment and infrastructure solutions provider was subscribed 38.69 times by the end of bidding on August 11, according to data available on the NSE.

The issue received bids for 32,17,81,040 equity shares against 83,17,190 shares on offer. The Non-Institutional Investor (NII) portion was subscribed 65.06 times, while the retail portion saw 25.35 times subscription.

The IPO opened for subscription on August 7 and closed on August 11. Technocraft Ventures had fixed the price band at Rs 200-212 per share.

How to check allotment status for Technocraft Ventures

Investors who applied for the IPO can check their allotment status through the IPO registrar, Bigshare Services, or through the BSE and NSE websites. Bigshare Services is the registrar to the issue.

Read Also: LEAP India IPO allotment today; check status on BSE, NSE and registrar

Technocraft Ventures IPO allotment on Bigshare

Step 1. Visit the Bigshare Services IPO status page at https://ipo.bigshareonline.com/ipo_status.html
Step 2. Select Technocraft Ventures from the list of issues.
Step 3. Enter the required details, such as PAN, application number or DP/Client ID.
Step 4. Enter the captcha, if applicable.
Step 5. Submit the details to view the allotment status.

Technocraft Ventures IPO allotment on BSE

1. Visit the BSE website at https://www.bseindia.com/investors/appli_check.aspx
2. Select Equity under issue type.
3. Select Technocraft Ventures from the issue name dropdown.
4. Enter either the PAN or the application number.
5. Click on submit to view the allotment status.

Technocraft Ventures IPO allotment on NSE

Step 1. Visit the NSE website at https://www.nseindia.com/invest/check-trades-bids-verify-ipo-bids
Step 2. Enter the required PAN and application details.
Step 3. Submit the information to check the bid and allotment status.
Step 4. The allotment information displayed on the exchanges is based on data provided by the registrar.

According to platforms tracking market activities, InvestorGain and IPO Watch, the grey market premium (GMP) for Technocraft Ventures was around Rs 29 per share on August 11. At the upper end of the IPO price band of Rs 212, a GMP of Rs 29 implies an estimated listing price of around Rs 241. This represents a potential premium of about 13.68 percent over the issue price.

However, the GMP is an unofficial indicator derived from activity in the grey market. It is not regulated by stock exchanges and can change before listing. Therefore, the GMP does not guarantee the actual listing price or listing gains.

The Rs 251.88-crore IPO comprises a fresh issue of 95.05 lakh equity shares and an offer for sale (OFS) of 23.76 lakh shares by promoter entity Kartikey Constructions.

The company plans to use the net proceeds from the fresh issue primarily to meet its working capital requirements, with the balance earmarked for general corporate purposes. The original offer documents had proposed Rs 138 crore for working capital requirements.

Technocraft Ventures had raised Rs 75.55 crore from anchor investors on August 6, a day before the IPO opened. The company allotted 35.63 lakh equity shares at Rs 212 apiece.

The anchor book included investors such as LRSD Securities, Vikasa India EIF I Fund, Nakshatra Bharat Vantage Fund and Venus Stellar Fund.

Khambatta Securities is the book-running lead manager for the IPO, while Bigshare Services is the registrar. The shares are scheduled to list on both the BSE and NSE on August 14.

Technocraft Ventures reported a net profit of Rs 43.3 crore in FY26, compared with Rs 28.2 crore in FY25, representing a year-on-year increase of 53.6 percent.

Check IPO News Here

Revenue from operations rose 23.4 percent year-on-year to Rs 345 crore in FY26 from Rs 279.6 crore in FY25. The company had an unexecuted order book worth Rs 1,320.7 crore as of July 15, 2026, providing visibility for its upcoming project execution.

The IPO is scheduled to be listed on August 14.

About Technocraft Ventures

Technocraft Ventures is a public infrastructure development company that undertakes turnkey engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) projects. Its business spans water supply, wastewater treatment, operation and maintenance of public utilities, electrical transmission and distribution, roads and highways, among other infrastructure activities.

1.headline: LEAP India IPO allotment today; check status on BSE, NSE and registrar
1.heading: LEAP India IPO allotment today; check status on BSE, NSE and registrar
1.intro: The share allotment for KKR-backed LEAP India’s Rs 2,480-crore initial public offering (IPO) is expected to be finalised today, on August 12, following strong demand across investor categories during the three-day bidding period.
1.body:
The share allotment for KKR-backed LEAP India’s Rs 2,480-crore initial public offering (IPO) is expected to be finalised today, on August 12, following strong demand across investor categories during the three-day bidding period.

The IPO, which opened for subscription on August 7 and closed on August 11, was subscribed 8.38 times overall. Investors bid for 96,32,58,796 equity shares against 11,49,91,735 shares on offer, according to exchange data.

Qualified Institutional Buyers (QIBs) and Non-Institutional Investors (NIIs) were the strongest contributors to the demand, while the retail portion was subscribed 1.71 times. The issue had a price band of Rs 151-159 per share, with the upper end of the band used for the final issue price.

How to check LEAP India IPO allotment

Investors who applied for the LEAP India IPO can check their allotment status through the BSE website, NSE's IPO bid/allotment verification facility and the IPO registrar, MUFG Intime India Private Limited.

Read Also: School teacher built Rs 80,000 crore Havells company: Qimat Rai Gupta came to Delhi with Rs 10,000 and changed India's electrical products business

LEAP India IPO allotment on BSE

Step 1. Visit the BSE website at https://www.bseindia.com/investors/appli_check.aspx
Step 2. Select LEAP India from the issue list.
Step 3. Choose the relevant option, such as PAN or application number.
Step 4. Enter the required details and submit.
Step 5. The allotment status will be displayed if the basis of allotment has been uploaded.

LEAP India IPO status on NSE

1. Visit the NSE website at https://www.nseindia.com/invest/check-trades-bids-verify-ipo-bids
2. Select the equity/SME IPO option.
3. Enter the PAN or application number.
4. Submit the details to view the bid information and allotment details provided by the registrar.
5. NSE says its IPO verification module also provides allotment information supplied by the registrar.

Allotment through MUFG Intime

Step 1. Visit the MUFG Intime IPO status page at https://in.mpms.mufg.com/Initial_Offer/public-issues.html
Step 2. Select LEAP India from the issue list.
Step 3. Enter the required details, such as PAN or application number.
Step 4. Submit the form to check whether shares have been allotted.

MUFG Intime is the registrar to the LEAP India IPO, according to the company's offer document.

Investors can also check their demat account after the allotment process. Successful applicants will receive the allotted shares in their demat accounts, while the blocked application amount for unsuccessful applications will be released as per the IPO timetable.

The grey market premium (GMP) for LEAP India stood at around Rs 13 per share as of August 12, according to market-tracking platforms InvestorGain and IPO Watch. At the upper end of the IPO price band of Rs 159, this GMP implied an estimated listing price of Rs 172. That translates into a potential premium of around 8.18 percent over the issue price.

Investors must note that the grey market premiums are unofficial and based on market speculation. They do not guarantee listing gains or reflect the company's fundamentals.

LEAP India raised Rs 2,480 crore through the public issue. The offering comprised a fresh issue of Rs 480 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) of Rs 2,000 crore by existing shareholders.

Check IPO News Here

The company plans to use Rs 360 crore from the fresh issue towards repayment of debt, with the remaining proceeds earmarked for general corporate purposes. Money raised through the OFS will go to the selling shareholders.

Before the IPO, LEAP India raised Rs 743.62 crore from 32 anchor investors through the allotment of 4.67 crore shares at Rs 159 apiece.

The anchor book included global investors such as the Monetary Authority of Singapore, Morgan Stanley, Norway's Government Pension Fund Global, Amundi, Citigroup, Societe Generale and Goldman Sachs, among others.

The IPO was managed by JM Financial, Avendus Capital, IIFL Capital Services and UBS Securities India. The shares are proposed to be listed on both the BSE and NSE.

About LEAP India

LEAP India provides technology-enabled supply chain and asset-pooling solutions. Its services include pooling of pallets, containers and material-handling equipment for industries such as FMCG, food and beverages, third-party logistics, e-commerce, quick commerce, automotive and industrials. The company was incorporated in 2013 and has KKR as a majority investor.

2.headline: Strong debut: Ardee Industries shares list at 39% premium over IPO price; should you buy, sell or hold?
2.heading: Strong debut: Ardee Industries shares list at 39% premium over IPO price; should you buy, sell or hold?
2.intro: Ardee Industries market debut was better than the expectations in the grey market, which had anticipated a listing gain of up to 32%.
2.body:
Ardee Industries shares made blockbuster listing gains of around 39 percent on Wednesday, following a whopping subscription of 133.66 times during its initial public offering (IPO) between August 5-7 in the primary market.

Shares of Ardee Industries were listed at Rs 73.60 per share on the BSE, a strong premium of 38.87 percent. The company's market capitalisation post listing of shares stood at Rs 2,319.88-crore.

On the NSE, the shares of the company were listed at Rs 72 per share, a decent premium of 35.85 percent. The Rs 426-crore issue had a price band of Rs 50-53 per share.

Ardee Industries market debut was better than the expectations in the grey market, which had anticipated a listing gain of about 30-32 percent.

Earlier, it raised Rs 128 crore from anchor investors.
Check All IPO News
Ardee Industries share listing today: Should you buy, sell or hold?
Shivani Nyati, Head of Wealth at Swastika Investmart, said: "The post-listing outlook remains positive, supported by attractive valuations, strong RoNW of 57.46%, healthy profitability and its presence in the growing circular economy and recycling space."

"However, after a sharp 36–39% listing gain, investors should avoid chasing the stock at higher levels and watch for profit-booking. IPO allottees can continue to hold with a stop-loss of Rs 65 on a closing basis, while fresh investors may consider buying only on meaningful dips," she added.

Ardee Industries is engaged in the circular economy segment, focusing on the recovery and recycling of end-of-life energy storage products and non-ferrous scrap. It also reclaims critical resources from waste streams and manufactures pure lead and lead alloys used in sectors such as energy storage, e-mobility, automotive and chemicals.
